caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright ceramic jug with a rounded body and a short, narrow neck that flares out at the top, forming a small circular opening. The jug is rendered in various shades of brown, with darker tones used to define the shadows and lighter, reddish-brown highlights indicating the curved surface and reflections. The surface of the jug shows subtle transitions in color and faint irregularities, suggesting a glazed ceramic texture. Near the top of the jug, above the curved shoulder, there is an inscription in capital letters that reads "C. CROLUG, MANUFACTURED, NEW YORK." The jug is centered on a light beige background, enclosed within a faint, hand-drawn rectangular border. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Ink Bottle
